job.source_title: Roman Reigns Calls Out LA Knight and Royce Keys After WWE Clash in Italy

blocks.text: Roman Reigns survived Tribal Combat at WWE Clash in Italy , but he wasn’t done sending messages after the show went off the air.

During the Clash in Italy post-show , Reigns called out LA Knight and Royce Keys after retaining the WWE World Heavyweight Championship against Jacob Fatu. Both men have been targeting Reigns lately, and The Tribal Chief made it clear he is not backing down from anyone coming after him or his family.

Reigns first made it clear that the bigger question is not what the win means for him, but what it means for everyone else: “I don’t really think it matters what it means for me, what does it mean for anyone else?” He then directly named LA Knight and Royce Keys, warning them and anyone else who wants to take shots at the Bloodline.

“I can hear the chattering. LA Knight, Royce Keys, and this goes for any of you chumps back there. You want to run your mouth about The Tribal Chief? You want to run your mouth about my family? You’re terrified about this Bloodline, ain’t you ? ”

“I can hear the chattering. LA Knight, Royce Keys, and this goes for any of you chumps back there. You want to run your mouth about The Tribal Chief? You want to run your mouth about my family? You’re terrified about this Bloodline, ain’t you ? ”
Reigns also said he has been trying to handle things the right way, but warned that his rivals keep forcing his hand, daring them and he made it clear he will continue to run WWE forever.
“I’ve been a general, I’ve been had an army. I’m trying to do this the right way, I’m trying to shine a light on my legacy, but you keep forcing my hand. Keep on trying me, I run it all, forever.”
“I’ve been a general, I’ve been had an army. I’m trying to do this the right way, I’m trying to shine a light on my legacy, but you keep forcing my hand. Keep on trying me, I run it all, forever.”

The comments came after Reigns defeated Jacob Fatu in a brutal Tribal Combat main event at the Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy. The match spilled through the crowd, featured weapons, barricade crashes, and a table spot before Reigns finally put Fatu away with a spear to retain his championship.

The win also kept Reigns undefeated in Tribal Combat matches, further cementing his grip on that brutal stipulation. However, his post-show comments made it clear that his title reign is far from calm, especially with LA Knight and Royce Keys now firmly in his sights.

Reigns may have ended Clash in Italy still champion, but his warning suggests the next chapter is already taking shape. Whether it is LA Knight, Royce Keys, or anyone else coming for the Tribal Chief, Roman made one thing clear: he still believes WWE runs through him.
